**Issue #3564 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3564: Patch: no flaky checks on main: the duos clock tests and two web unit timeouts
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

Since 2026-11-06, 11 push runs of `ci.yml` on `main` have failed (80 passed, 33 were cancelled). Nine of those 11 failed on a flaky test or a network error, with nothing wrong in the commit. Each one turns `main` red, which keeps `promote-staging.yml` (it takes `main`'s newest green commit) from moving, and costs a re-run. The same commits mostly passed the merge queue: `main` re-runs every check, so it hits more flakes.

## Flaky tests

| Check | Test | Failure | On `main` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rust (test server)` | `actor::duos::b36_the_ai_seats::b36_the_ai_team_plays_its_round_a_step_at_a_time_and_hands_it_back_before_the_round_clock` | panicked at `crates/server/tests/actor/duos.rs:1098`: "the AI team ends its round before the round clock would" | 310f441 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42423957565)); the queue passed it ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42422432928)) |
| `rust (test server)` | `actor::duos::r268_the_mulligan_clock::r268_the_mulligan_clock_keeps_each_owing_persons_whole_hand_never_the_ais_mulligan` | panicked at `crates/server/tests/actor/duos.rs:1925`: `A2 keeps c5: dealt ["c11", "c20", "c5"], holds ["c11", "c20", "c17"]` | 98e7f80 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42337953298)); the queue passed it ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42337051248)) |
| `web (unit 8/8)` | `src/wording.test.ts` > R373 no text a player can read in the client says library or sacrifice | `Test timed out in 5000ms`; the R503 tests beside it take 5.2–5.9 s | bad4402 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42553956811)) and 43c6712 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42571618996)); the queue passed 43c6712 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42566724833)) and skipped bad4402's web units |
| `web (unit 7/8)` | `src/cards/art/scene.test.ts` > R3331000 every part draws clean shapes from any seed | `Test timed out in 5000ms` (5027 ms) | 197311a ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42464623206)); the queue passed it ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42462947022)) |
| `bot selftest` | `bot/go/tests` `TestOwnReview_ARedCICheckItReadsIsFixedInTheSameRun` | `TempDir RemoveAll cleanup: unlinkat …/001/deliver/.git/objects/pack: directory not empty`: something still writes the repository when the test ends | ca75d33 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42632312446)); the queue skipped the job, and it passed on every later commit |

Both duos tests race the actor's clocks. The two web tests are heavy and sit at vitest's default 5 s timeout on a busy runner.

## Network errors, not tests

| Check | Failure | On `main` |
|---|---|---|
| `rust (checks, fuzz 200)`, step `infra (terraform validate)` | `terraform init -backend=false` got `504 Gateway Timeout` from github.com fetching the pinned providers | 197311a ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42464623206)), c4a2b56 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42578355247)), e8d5f21 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42581133983)): three in 24 hours |
| `db (deploy image deps)` | `docker/setup-buildx-action` failed to authorize against Docker Hub | 03900c9 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42169412184)) |
| `e2e smoke` | both shards came back `abandoned` without running | a52cde4 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42664922275)) |

Retrying `terraform init`, or caching the providers, would keep the first one off `main`.

## Not flakes

- #3457's queue build at 06:44 UTC on 2026-11-09 really did fail `web (unit 5/8)`. R3397000 in `setAltScenes.test.tsx` counted R3340000's motion recipes as full-art motions. The bot's revise (f9e3e47) fixed the test, and the next queue build passed. #3450's handoff listed it as a flake.
- `bot selftest` on 2026-11-06 (03900c9, cbe5de1): `tests.test_ci_matrix` still expected 4 web shards after `scripts/ci-shards.toml` moved to 8. The queue skipped the job. No later run on `main` fails it.

## For whoever builds it

The bots may not change `.github/` or `bot/` (`forbidden_paths`), so the bot test's temp dir and the `terraform init` retry in `ci.yml` moved to #3616, a person's issue (2026-11-10). This issue is the rest, the night bot's: the two duos clock tests (`crates/server/tests/actor/duos.rs`) and the two web unit timeouts (`apps/web/src/wording.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/cards/art/scene.test.ts`).

- Fix each duos test's race against the actor's clocks so it passes on a busy runner, never by skipping or disabling it (CLAUDE.md rule 12). Run each one many times in a loop to show it holds.
- Make each web test cheaper, or give it a timeout of its own where it is heavy by design, as a named constant.
- The `db` and `e2e smoke` network errors need no change here.

Found while closing #3292 (handoff on #3450).
```
